comments.body:
I was average in Swiss High School, failed the Basisprüfung the first time and quite a few other exams. It was stressful at times and there was sometimes the fear of dropping out. However it is definitely possible for the average person with enough dedication. I still somehow managed to finish computer science, got into a good internship and now make a lot more than any of my way smarter peers in high school or studies.

ETH brand is very strong, especially here in Switzerland. If you manage to finish it nobody will really care for any of your grades.
comments.author: No-Grapefruit1341
